name: Helius
description: Solana blockchain data through Helius: SOL and token balances, NFTs and tokens of a wallet (DAS API), readable transaction history, single transactions, wallet identity and funding source. Read-only.
instructions:
## Helius
This connector reads the Solana blockchain through **Helius**: standard Solana RPC (`https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com`), the DAS API for NFTs and tokens, Enhanced Transactions for human-readable history and the Wallet API (`https://api.helius.xyz/v1/wallet`, beta). Everything is read-only: no transaction is signed or sent.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign up at https://dashboard.helius.dev (the Free plan works).
2. Open **API Keys** and copy a key into `HELIUS_API_KEY`. It is sent as the `api-key` query parameter.
3. Run `helius_get_epoch_info` to check the key.

**Workflow**
- Balances: `helius_get_balance` for SOL in lamports (divide by 1,000,000,000), `helius_get_assets_by_owner` with `show_fungible` and `show_native_balance` for everything a wallet holds, `helius_get_token_accounts` for raw token accounts by owner or mint, `helius_get_wallet_balances` for a USD-valued portfolio.
- One asset or token: `helius_get_asset` with the mint address.
- History: `helius_get_address_transactions` (readable types and transfers, 100 per call, page with `before_signature`), `helius_get_wallet_history` (balance changes per transaction), `helius_get_wallet_transfers` (transfers only), or `helius_get_signatures_for_address` (raw signatures, up to 1000) followed by `helius_get_transaction` or `helius_parse_transactions` for details.
- Who is this wallet: `helius_get_wallet_identity` (exchanges, protocols, known entities) and `helius_get_wallet_funded_by` (first SOL funder).
- Chain status: `helius_get_epoch_info`.

**Units and times**: SOL amounts from RPC are lamports (10^9 per SOL). Token amounts from `helius_get_token_accounts` are raw integers; divide by 10^decimals of the mint. `blockTime` and `timestamp` are Unix seconds (UTC).

**Credits and limits**: each plan has monthly credits (Free 1M). Standard RPC calls cost 1 credit, DAS and Enhanced calls more, every Wallet API call 100 credits. Rate limits on the Free plan: RPC 10 requests per second, DAS and Enhanced APIs 2 per second. Prefer the RPC and DAS tools for routine questions and the Wallet API for the questions only it answers.

**Errors**: 401 means a missing or wrong API key. 429 means the plan rate limit or the monthly credits are used up. RPC errors come back as a JSON-RPC `error` object (for example an invalid address). The Wallet API answers 404 when it knows no identity or funder for the wallet.

**Limitations**: mainnet only (devnet is not configured). Enhanced Transactions is in maintenance mode at Helius; the Wallet API is beta and its formats may change. Webhooks, streaming, priority fees and sending transactions are not part of this connector.

HELIUS_API_KEY.label: API key
HELIUS_API_KEY.help: dashboard.helius.dev, API Keys: copy a key. The Free plan works.
HELIUS_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key (a UUID such as 1a2b3c4d-...), not the whole RPC URL.

verifyHints.401: Helius refused the API key. Copy it again from dashboard.helius.dev (API Keys), only the key, not the RPC URL.
verifyHints.429: The Helius plan rate limit or the monthly credits are used up. Wait a moment or check the usage in the Helius dashboard.

tools.name: helius_get_epoch_info
tools.description: Get the current Solana epoch: epoch number, slot index and slots in the epoch, absolute slot, block height and transaction count. Costs one RPC credit; use it to check the connection and to know the current slot.

tools.name: helius_get_balance
tools.description: Get the native SOL balance of an account in lamports (value; 1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports) with the slot it was read at.

tools.name: helius_get_assets_by_owner
tools.description: List the digital assets a wallet owns through the DAS API: NFTs, compressed NFTs and, with show_fungible, SPL and Token-2022 tokens with balance, decimals and price where known; show_native_balance adds the SOL balance. Paged: page starts at 1, limit up to 1000.

show_fungible.description: Include fungible tokens (SPL, Token-2022) with balances.

show_native_balance.description: Include the SOL balance of the wallet.

show_zero_balance.description: Include token accounts with a zero balance.

tools.name: helius_get_asset
tools.description: Get one digital asset (NFT, compressed NFT or token) by its id (mint address) through the DAS API: interface, name, symbol, metadata and image links, ownership, collection grouping, royalties, creators, supply and, for tokens, decimals and price info.

tools.name: helius_get_token_accounts
tools.description: List SPL token accounts by owner or by mint through the DAS API: token account address, mint, owner, amount (raw, apply the mint decimals) and frozen state. Give owner, mint or both. Paged with page and limit.

mint.description: Token mint address (base58), e.g. EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v for USDC.

tools.name: helius_get_signatures_for_address
tools.description: List transaction signatures that touched an address, newest first: signature, slot, blockTime (Unix seconds), err (null on success) and memo. Default and maximum 1000; page with before = the last signature received. Fetch the details with helius_get_transaction.

until.description: Stop at this signature (fetch only newer ones).

tools.name: helius_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one confirmed transaction by signature with parsed instructions (jsonParsed): slot, blockTime, fee, status, account keys, pre and post SOL and token balances and log messages. Transaction versions legacy, 0 and 1 are accepted.

tools.name: helius_get_address_transactions
tools.description: Get the human-readable transaction history of an address (Enhanced Transactions): type (TRANSFER, SWAP, NFT_SALE...), source, description, fee, timestamp, nativeTransfers and tokenTransfers. Newest first, up to 100 per call; page with before_signature = the last signature received. token_accounts=balanceChanged also includes transfers that only touched the wallet token accounts.

before_signature.description: Return transactions older than this signature (paging).

after_signature.description: Return transactions newer than this signature.

type.description: Only this transaction type, e.g. TRANSFER, SWAP, NFT_SALE.

token_accounts.description: none (default), balanceChanged or all: include activity of token accounts the address owns.

gte_time.description: Only transactions at or after this block time (Unix seconds).

lte_time.description: Only transactions at or before this block time (Unix seconds).

tools.name: helius_parse_transactions
tools.description: Turn up to 100 transaction signatures into human-readable transactions (Enhanced Transactions): type, source, description, fee, native and token transfers and events. Reads only; nothing is sent to the chain.

tools.name: helius_get_wallet_balances
tools.description: Get the token balances of a wallet with USD values (Wallet API, beta): mint, symbol, balance, pricePerToken, usdValue and totalUsdValue for the page, sorted by value. Prices are hourly estimates for about the top 10,000 tokens and may be null. 100 per page. Costs 100 credits.

show_zero_balance.description: Include tokens with a zero balance.

show_nfts.description: Also list NFTs (first page only, at most 100).

tools.name: helius_get_wallet_history
tools.description: Get the transaction history of a wallet with its balance changes per transaction (Wallet API, beta): signature, timestamp, fee and balanceChanges (mint, amount, decimals), newest first. Up to 100 per call; page with before = pagination cursor from the previous answer. Costs 100 credits.

before.description: Pagination cursor from the previous answer.

type.description: Only this transaction type, e.g. SWAP, TRANSFER, NFT_SALE.

tools.name: helius_get_wallet_transfers
tools.description: List incoming and outgoing transfers of a wallet (Wallet API, beta): signature, timestamp, direction (in or out), counterparty, mint and amount. Default 50, up to 100 per call; page with cursor from the previous answer. Costs 100 credits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous answer.

tools.name: helius_get_wallet_identity
tools.description: Identify a known wallet (Wallet API, beta): name and category such as a centralized exchange, protocol or institution. Also accepts a .sol domain. Unknown wallets answer 404. Costs 100 credits.

address.description: Wallet address (base58) or .sol domain, e.g. toly.sol.

tools.name: helius_get_wallet_funded_by
tools.description: Find who first funded a wallet with SOL (Wallet API, beta): funder address, funderName and funderType (exchange or null), amount, timestamp and signature. 404 means no funding transfer was found. Costs 100 credits.
